application_sentences: It is developed as a stand alone device used for speedy monitoring of melt mass flow rate.
It is mainly used for goods inwards checks at plastics procedure plants where extrusion tests are worked on a variable basis.
These extrusion plastometers are typically used for quality assurance and incoming goods inspections.

Instron reported that their new, modular CEAST MF20 and MF30 Melt Flow Testers are versatile single-weight measurement systems suitable for use both in research and development and in advanced quality control.
6 kg for testing a wide spectrum of materials, from fast-flowing masterbatches to highly viscous elastomers or filled thermoplastic polymers.

both models can be extended with additional modules, including a die plugging device to prevent material flowing during pre-heating, a nitrogen blanket device for testing hygroscopic materials, an acid-resistant version for chemically aggressive materials and the CEAST VisualMelt Software for storage, analysis and graphical presentation of results.
